proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5267 jemati explicitly includes Punjabi jeuṇā eat/dine, Bhojpuri jẽwal and Hindi jewnā. Hadothi jeo eat matches the jeu-/jew- regional family; its imperative ending and vowel sequence are retained. The deeper Munda proposal is disputed in the primary entry, and no direct Indo-Aryan borrowing route is asserted. Exact response: jeo.
